svg.title: nlm_audit example session
svg.desc: Example session: asked to audit the AI & Automation notebook, the assistant calls nlm_audit. Result: 56 sources, 3 fresh, 3 aging, 5 stale, 45 unknown, 0 pinned. Stale: Model X Just Shipped a Major Update (news, 134d old, over by 104d); Stop Using This Old Prompting Trick (tactics, 118d old, over by 73d); 20 Terminal Shortcuts in 20 Minutes (tool, 126d old, over by 66d); 30 Tricks to Speed Up Your Workflow (tool, 100d old, over by 40d); Building Agents with the New SDK (tool, 77d old, over by 17d). Duplicates: 1 title × 2 copies. YouTube searches used: 20. Reply: Found 5 stale sources and 1 duplicate, mostly time-sensitive news and tactics videos past their shelf life. Want me to remove any of these?
